subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing 'Q' on it?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b69577f4f0c540dd1d604822ab8415f0aa183b7b2cc0a831ff9da656c194b4ca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81cc1c4f5d0d28ed49e41743b82fcd8672ffdf312c09390f178a4f8317209533.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'Q', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a3f9542e137902ebd5dc7e598c20bf1ab479e620d81fae54c98d0a6f15f7aab.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/227e1925be7738d58cf77727c186374eac020849869594c9eaf6c9fae303059c.png] 

From both dices, P is common. When rotating in clockwise direction start from P.

P ⇔ P; **Q ⇔ M**; X ⇔ R

So, the 'M' will be the opposite face of 'Q'.

Hence, the correct answer is "M".
